decisions.reason: The shop relaunch SEO service has stayed on its own page for two years, so it shows some sustained value, and keeping a consultancy service listed costs little, which makes holding the option sensible even after the firm pruned its plugin options.

The SEO workshops launched only in 2024, so their prospects are still uncertain, and they cost little to maintain while drawing on existing SEO expertise, so the option should stay open until more results come in.
